subject: [PATCH v3 08/12] mm/collapse: separate scanning a PTE table from collapsing it

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch separates the scanning of a PTE table from its collapse into two distinct functions: `collapse_scan_pmd` and `collapse_run_pmd`. The scan function reads the PTE table under the mmap_lock, while the run function performs the actual collapse. This change improves code organization and reduces the complexity of the original `collapse_single_pmd` function.
